preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The size of the array is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the array is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of T lines, each containing 2 numbers separated by a space
postconditions.description: Each line contains the selected index for rotation and the maximum number of inversions found.

postconditions.expression: output[i][0] is an integer between 0 and N-1, inclusive
postconditions.description: The selected index for rotation in the i-th test case is within the bounds of the array size.

postconditions.expression: output[i][1] is an integer representing the number of inversions in the lexicographically smallest left rotation
postconditions.description: The number of inversions is calculated correctly for each rotation.

postconditions.expression: if multiple rotations have the same number of inversions, the smallest index is chosen
postconditions.description: In case of a tie, the smallest index of rotation is selected.
